popCulture.title: Bibliotheca
popCulture.creator: Pseudo-Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Apollodorus makes Electryon the Perseid king of Mycenae whose daughter Alcmene bears Heracles — and whose accidental death at Amphitryon's hand sends the future stepfather into exile.

popCulture.title: Electryon
popCulture.description: Son of Perseus and Andromeda; father of Alcmene — the hinge between the Perseid house and the birth of Heracles.
